lostfound.permission.read: See lost and found items, matches and claims
lostfound.permission.manage: Record guests' lost items, decide matches, store and dispose of items
lostfound.permission.release: Hand an item back to its owner against a claim record
lostfound.setting.retention_days: Days an unclaimed found item is kept before it may be disposed of
lostfound.setting.ai_attributes: Let AI read item descriptions to help match lost and found items
lostfound.setting.ai_vision: Let AI read photos of found items (the photo is sent without its metadata; off by default)
